effects.description:
When spawning: Acquire a defensive shield (durability: 30% of max HP).
While defensive shield is active, enemy attacks will reduce shield durability instead of HP, and it will inflict Stagger on the enemy who attacked you. (Excludes some attacks.)

skills.detail:
A long-range charge attack with a Knockback effect.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: The Dark King's Flash

skills.detail:
Reduces damage received from enemies while the skill button is held down.
Deals a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
